ChromieSandBlastOnceAgainTheFirstTime.name: Once Again the First Time
ChromieSandBlastOnceAgainTheFirstTime.description: Quest: Hit 40 Heroes with Sand Blast from Chromie or her Echoes. Reward: Increase the maximum number of active Echoes to 2, and increase Echo damage to 45%.

ChromieDragonsBreathDeepBreathing.name: Deep Breathing
ChromieDragonsBreathDeepBreathing.description: Quest: Every time Dragon's Breath hits a Hero increase its damage by 1%, up to 20%. Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes, reduce the cooldown of Dragon's Breath by 4 seconds and its Mana cost from 65 to 40.

ChromieTimewalkersPursuit.name: Timewalker's Pursuit
ChromieTimewalkersPursuit.description: Gain 10% Spell Power and reduce the arming time of Time Traps by 0.75 seconds. Activate to reveal the targeted area for 4 seconds. Enemies seen are revealed for 4 seconds.

ChromieTimeTrapChronicConditions.name: Chronic Conditions
ChromieTimeTrapChronicConditions.description: After its Time Stop ends, enemies affected by Time Trap are Slowed by 30% for 3 seconds and allies gain 30% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

ChromieTimeTrapTimeTroubles.name: Time Troubles
ChromieTimeTrapTimeTroubles.description: After its Time Stop ends, enemies affected by Time Trap lose 15 Armor for 3 seconds and allies gain 30 Armor for 3 seconds.

ChromieTimeTrapAndorhalAnomaly.name: Andorhal Anomaly
ChromieTimeTrapAndorhalAnomaly.description: Increase the charges and maximum active Time Traps to 3, and reduce its cooldown by 8 seconds.

ChromieSandBlastBronzeTalons.name: Bronze Talons
ChromieSandBlastBronzeTalons.description: Hitting a Hero with Sand Blast from Chromie or her Echoes grants 50% additional Basic Attack damage for 5 seconds.

ChromieDragonsBreathMobiusLoop.name: Mobius Loop
ChromieDragonsBreathMobiusLoop.description: Dragon's Breath deals 30% bonus damage to enemies hit by its center. Enemy Heroes hit by its center are Slowed by 60% for 0.75 seconds.

ChromieAProperGreeting.name: A Proper Greeting
ChromieAProperGreeting.description: Damaging a Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed enemy Hero grants 20% additional damage for 3 seconds.

ChromieHeroicAbilitySlowingSands.name: Slowing Sands
ChromieHeroicAbilitySlowingSands.description: Summon a sand vortex that Slows enemies by 10% every 0.25 seconds, up to 70%.

ChromieHeroicAbilityTemporalLoop.name: Temporal Loop
ChromieHeroicAbilityTemporalLoop.description: Choose an enemy Hero. After 3 seconds, they are teleported back to the location where Temporal Loop was cast on them. Basic Abilities recharge 500% faster for 3 seconds after casting Temporal Loop.

ChromieSandBlastGnomeSpeedAhead.name: Gnome Speed Ahead!
ChromieSandBlastGnomeSpeedAhead.description: After casting Sand Blast, Chromie gains 20% Movement Speed and 200% increased Health Regeneration for 3 seconds.

ChromieHereAndThere.name: Here and There
ChromieHereAndThere.description: Activate to teleport to an area near an Echo, swapping it with Chromie's previous location.

ChromieTimeOut.name: Time Out
ChromieTimeOut.description: Activate to place Chromie in Stasis and gain Invulnerability for up to 5 seconds. Can be reactivated to end the effect early.

ChromieSandBlastShiftingSands.name: Shifting Sands
ChromieSandBlastShiftingSands.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Chromie's primary Sand Blast grants 5% Spell Power for 8 seconds, up to a maximum of 50%. The duration is refreshed whenever an enemy is damaged by the primary Sand Blast.

ChromieSandBlastFastForward.name: Fast Forward
ChromieSandBlastFastForward.description: If Chromie's primary Sand Blast travels at least 50% of its base distance and hits a Hero, its cooldown is reduced to 0.5 seconds and it refunds 10 Mana.

ChromieQuantumOverdrive.name: Quantum Overdrive
ChromieQuantumOverdrive.description: Activate to increase Spell Power by 30% for 8 seconds. Hitting an enemy Hero with Sand Blast reduces this cooldown by 3 seconds.

ChromieSlowingSandsUnravelling.name: Unravelling
ChromieSlowingSandsUnravelling.description: Every 0.25 seconds, enemy Heroes Slowed by Slowing Sands have their Spell Armor reduced by 10 up to 50. Slowing Sands persists for 5 seconds after it is cancelled.

ChromieTemporalLoopStuckInALoop.name: Stuck in a Loop
ChromieTemporalLoopStuckInALoop.description: Temporal Loop teleports the target a second time after the first, and Basic Abilities continue recharging for an additional 3 seconds. Increase the cooldown recharge rate from 500% to 700%.

ChromieSandBlastPiercingSands.name: Piercing Sands
ChromieSandBlastPiercingSands.description: Sand Blasts cast from Chromie and her Echoes now pierce all enemies hit.

ChromieBlessingOfTheBronze.name: Blessing of the Bronze
ChromieBlessingOfTheBronze.description: Activate to cause Chromie and all allied Heroes to gain 20% Movement Speed and their Basic Abilities recharge 35% faster for 8 seconds. Hitting an enemy Hero with Sand Blast from Chromie or her Echoes reduces the cooldown of Blessing of the Bronze by 1 second.
